Borgerhout — Antwerp, Belgium

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

Dense, young and mixed, just east of the centre. An explosive device detonated at a house here in August 2025, damaging the front door and a parked car with no injuries; a suspect was arrested. Antwerp handles more cocaine than any other European port, and the conflict between the clans that move it is the defining safety story of the city. VRT reported that the federal judicial police in Antwerp opened 45 new investigations into drug-related violence in 2025 — explosives, shootings, kidnappings, arson — after 91 recorded incidents across the province in 2024, and that gangs increasingly recruit minors as disposable perpetrators. What that violence is, in practice, is targeted: a device left at a specific front door or car, in a dispute between people who know each other. The two 2025 explosions reported below both damaged a door and injured nobody. It is serious, it is not aimed at passers-by, and it happens in residential streets rather than where visitors go.

Frequently asked questions

Is Borgerhout safe?

Wandroz currently rates Borgerhout in Antwerp as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Antwerp during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Antwerp at night. This comes from a structured local-source assessment: an area-level review of credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — consolidated across sources rather than taken from a single report. Is Borgerhout safe at night?

At night, Borgerhout is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Antwerp. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Borgerhout a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Borgerhout's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Antwerp) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
